V. 44.
While ye receive honour—That is, while ye ſeek the Praiſe of Men rather than the Praiſe of GOD. At the Feaſt of Pentecoſt, kept in Commemoration of the giving the Law from Mount Sinai, their Sermons uſe to be full of the Praiſes of the Law, and of the People to whom it was given. How mortifying then muſt the following Words of our LORD be to them, while they were thus exulting in Moſes and his Law?
